blind.description: A small Egyptian-style canopic jar with a falcon-headed lid (representing Qebehsenuef). The body is rounded and tapered toward the flat base, banded with dull gold/brass stripes around a dark green/bronze ceramic or stone body. The head lid features stylized painted eye and beak markings with gold detailing over a dark green sculpted surface. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully manifold with no loose floating pieces or spikes.
blind.from_above: A small circular profile displaying the dark green top of the falcon head, with gold crest/beak/eye markings pointing toward the bottom-left corner.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 to 1/7 the height of the figure (around 9 to 11 inches tall) and about 5 inches in diameter at its widest point.
